title: Emissive Sculk Sensors
description: Adds emissive Sculk Sensors. The regular and calibrated sculk sensor have a slight glow whereas the amethyst Calibrated Sculk Sensor has a strong glow visible in the dark
body:
This pack makes primarily makes the calibrated sculk sensors emissive in-game by changing the amethyst on the model of the block to have light emission, which causes it to be bright and glow in the dark, and this is a fully vanilla feature as the light_emission field for models was added in 1.21.2. 

The regular sculk sensor is also slightly emissive, but not by much, as well as the body of the calibrated sculk sensor.
